# Install the workshop materials for Causal Inference in R

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-universe version](https://r-causal.r-universe.dev/causalworkshop/badges/version)](https://r-causal.r-universe.dev/causalworkshop)
<!-- badges: end -->

## Installation

You can install causalworkshop from [r-causal.r-universe.dev](https://r-causal.r-universe.dev/) with:

``` r
install.packages(
  "causalworkshop",
  repos = c("https://r-causal.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos"))
)
```

You can also install the development version of causalworkshop from [GitHub](https://github.com/r-causal/causalworkshop) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("r-causal/causalworkshop")
```

Once you've installed the package, install the workshop with

``` r
causalworkshop::install_workshop()
```

By default, this package downloads the materials to a conspicuous place like your Desktop. You can also tell `install_workshop()` exactly where to put the materials:

``` r
causalworkshop::install_workshop("a/path/on/your/computer")
```
